title: Dolly and Her Little Red Umbrella
summary: Dolly the duckling can't find the little red umbrella she got from Grandma. She goes out in the rain to look for it and asks all her friends along the way.
pages: Dolly the duckling had a little red umbrella that she got from her beloved Grandma. When it was sunny and when it was cloudy, Dolly took it with her everywhere.
One rainy day Dolly wanted to go to Grandma's, but she couldn't find her umbrella. "Oh, no!" she cried. Dolly looked up high, Dolly looked down low. "Where can it be? Maybe someone has seen it?"

Dolly ran outside and met Chirpy the squirrel. "Have you seen my little red umbrella?" asked Dolly. "No," said Chirpy, "but you can take mine." "Thank you so much, you're a wonderful friend, but I have to find my little red umbrella quickly," said Dolly, and she kept walking along the river.

Freckles the frog was resting on a log. "Have you seen my little red umbrella?" asked Dolly. "No," said Freckles, "but you can take mine." "Thank you so much, you're a wonderful friend. But I really won't give up on my little red umbrella," said Dolly, and she hurried to paddle down the river.

Hero the mouse was just coming out of his house. "Have you seen my little red umbrella?" asked Dolly. "No," said Hero, "but you can take mine." "Oh, no..." cried Dolly, and her eyes filled with tears. "I want my umbrella. It's been with me for many years."

Suddenly the rain stopped, and Dolly looked up. There stood Grandma, with her polka-dot umbrella! "It was a lovely sunny day when you last visited me. You must have forgotten it, and the umbrella stayed in the corner at my house," smiled Grandma, holding Dolly's little red umbrella.
